The objection correctly identifies the induction's flaw: the inductive claim is only valid for transversals meeting C, and at the recursive call C\\{c} need not lie in F_c, so transversals of F_c need not meet it; the hypothesis cannot be invoked as stated. Worse, the Lemma is false (ledger L6.2: F_k = {x_1,...,x_k, y_k} is pairwise intersecting with infinitely many minimal finite transversals), so no local edit repairs it. The genuine finiteness input, large-prime erasure using minimality of the a_n, appears nowhere in the text."
